start: Linked to a gym that has saved its opening hours; Gym tab open

user_sees: A clock row whose title is the open status, e.g. 'Open now · closes 10:00 pm', and under it 'Today <hours>'
must_not: No row, or a status worked out in the phone's own time zone instead of India time

user_sees: Screen 'Gym timings': the open status, '<gym name> · India time', the gym's note if any, and a 'This week' card with today highlighted
must_not: A blank screen or another gym's hours

user_sees: The spinner, then the newest hours from the gym
must_not: Old hours kept after the gym changed them, or a second copy of the list

start: Gym has a holiday or special day within the next 7 days

user_sees: The clock row's second line names the special day by itself (the holiday notice), not today's hours
must_not: The holiday hidden until the day itself, or shown for a day more than 7 days away

user_sees: 'Gym timings' with the special day marked in 'This week'
must_not: The normal hours shown for the holiday

start: Linked gym has not set any hours (or the server lacks the hours function)

user_sees: No clock row at all
must_not: An empty card, a spinner or an error on the Gym tab

steps.action: Open the hours page from a link (route /shop/hours)
user_sees: 'No timings yet' and '<gym name> hasn't added its opening times in MettleUp yet. Ask at the desk.'
must_not: Made-up hours, 'Open now' with no hours, or a crash

start: Hours were shown once and kept on the phone

steps.action: Owner changes the hours in the admin panel; member reopens the hours page after 10 minutes
user_sees: The new hours (asked again because the page opened)
must_not: The old hours still shown after a pull or after 10 minutes

user_sees: The kept hours are forgotten; no clock row
must_not: The old gym's hours still shown after leaving, or shown for the next gym joined

start: Linked member opens 'Gym timings'

user_sees: Only the gym's public opening hours, note and specials; nothing about other members
must_not: Hours of another gym kept on this phone shown (the copy is matched to the linked gym id)

note: Gym's note and special-day note are free text shown in the row's second line
'Open now' and 'today' use India time (indiaNow); check a phone in Dubai and the 23:59 to 00:00 switch of today's line
Offline keeps the kept copy; a failed ask still blocks the next automatic ask for 10 minutes
Status and day words come from shared theme code; check Hinglish
Week rows use a fixed 96 px day column
Kept copy in AsyncStorage key forgeai-gym-hours is read back by the new version
Owner saves hours in the panel; the app should show them within 10 minutes as the panel promises

start: Linked to a gym with the leaderboard live and a running monthly challenge; member has logged workouts

steps.action: Save a workout with at least one working set
user_sees: Nothing new on screen; the phone sends that day's workout count and kg at once
must_not: Exercise names, sets, body weight, photos or notes sent to the gym

steps.action: Open the Gym tab, open the leaderboard card
user_sees: 'Leaderboard · last 30 days' with tabs 'Workouts' and kg, the top 10 and the member's own place as 'You'
must_not: The member's new workout missing after the push, or a rank shown for a member with nothing counted

user_sees: The challenge title, the member's progress toward the goal and the end day
must_not: A check-in challenge shown with workout numbers by an app that cannot read it

user_sees: 'You hit the goal: <n> free days. Show this screen at the desk.'
must_not: '1 free days' for one day, or a hit shown before the goal is reached

start: Member flips the name switch in Settings, Your gym, 'What my gym can see'

steps.action: Turn on "Show my name on my gym's leaderboard"
user_sees: Caption: on, others see first name and first letter of last name; the phone sends the switch at once
must_not: The switch staying 'A member' on the board after a refresh

steps.action: Turn it off with no signal, then get signal
user_sees: The next app start or Gym tab visit sends the 'off' (kept as pending)
must_not: The name staying public because the 'off' was lost offline

start: Gym's server has no leaderboard yet, or the gym's plan does not include challenge, or the phone holds demo data

user_sees: No leaderboard card; Settings may say "Your gym's leaderboard is not switched on yet."
must_not: An empty card, an error, or demo workouts sent to the real gym

steps.action: Log a day above 60,000 kg (bad data)
user_sees: That day is left out of the push entirely
must_not: A crazy kg figure on the board

start: Member is on the board, then leaves the gym

user_sees: 'Your workouts stay on this phone. Your leaderboard numbers are removed from the gym.'
must_not: The member's name or totals still on the board for other members after leaving

steps.action: Start of a new month: open the challenge card
user_sees: The new challenge (only one runs at a time) and progress from zero
must_not: Last month's progress counted in the new challenge

start: Name switch off (default)

user_sees: This member shows as 'A member'
must_not: First name or initial visible to other members while the switch is off

user_sees: Staff see the member's name with the daily totals, as the app says
must_not: Exercises, weights per lift, body weight or photos visible to staff

note: Empty board words exist; names are cut to 40 letters, challenge titles to 60
Day totals keyed by date; a workout around midnight and the monthly challenge start/end
Push after a save is quiet on failure; retried on next start after a minute
Board shows kg; a lb user must still see a true figure with its unit
Rank rows with names and values; title was renamed to fit big text
An older app reading a check-in challenge must hide the card, not show a wrong one
Owner starts the challenge in the panel; a workout logged from the watch must count
